_comment: Intended install: npx ui8kit@3 init --yes --framework svelte --dir src && npx ui8kit@3 add box text button icon input textarea form label link separator. Primitives in src/ui follow the ui8kit/codegen Svelte 5 contract (tag retag, no CSS in primitives). Refresh from the registry when CDN/npm is available; do not hand-edit generated kit files after that.
